name: MongoDB
description: This Test Connection validates the access against the database and basic metadata extraction of collections.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that we can properly reach the database and authenticate with the given credentials.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to mongoDB, please validate the credentials

steps.name: GetDatabases
steps.description: List the databases available to the user, keeping the ones `Database Schema` and `Schema Filter Pattern` target.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch databases, please validate if the user has enough privilege to fetch databases.

steps.name: GetCollections
steps.description: List the collections of the databases in scope. Passes as soon as one of them can be read.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch collections, please validate if the user has `listCollections` privilege on the databases in scope
